title: Universality in random graphs via optimal linking systems: trees and beyond
summary: We develop a framework for proving universality results in sparse random graphs. As a first application, we show that there exists an absolute constant $C>1$ such that, with high probability, for every fixed constant $Δ$, the binomial random graph $G(n,C\ln n/n)$ contains every $n$-vertex tree with maximum degree at most $Δ$. This answers a question of Montgomery (Advances in Mathematics, 2019).
